fortress: How do I stab a balloon to make it pop?

Hold the balloon steady and press a sharp pin or needle quickly into the side near the knot, where the latex is taut. One swift, firm poke will pop it loudly. For a quieter result, stretch the neck slightly and snip it with scissors so it deflates instead of bursting.
